scope: All legal fourths after every outer-ring favorable third. All legal sixths after one selected fourth/runtime-priority fifth per each of nine D4 third classes. Later paths, when present, are selected counter branches, not every future reply.

laterScope.selectionPolicy: At most three legal sixth moves per family: the pinned 3000ms selected opponent move followed by the first same-completed-depth, complete-PV candidate alternatives in the recorded engine order. The own seventh must follow the actual augmented runtime source/old-C/new-C priority before any later branch is expanded. This is bounded representative selection, not a strongest-defense proof.
